answer: An hostile operator hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The signal schedule is applied in nadir and voyage makes public each instalment. A payout is split and thus 47% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1252 identities would post 3518 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
